name: timeline-steps
title: Timeline Steps
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 5 animated timeline variants: https://avaraui.com/view/animated-timeline. This is the Steps timeline. Skip the question if the user already named one. A scroll-linked step list: numbered nodes on a rail that fills with the accent colour as you scroll, with the step in focus kept sharp. Use it for a company history or a dated changelog.
docs: Named exports: TimelineStepsBlock (also uses timeline-kit-theme.ts and timeline-scroll.ts, which install alongside). Items take { id, title, date?, description?, content?, action? }. It follows the scroll of its nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page; click a node to scroll to it. `defaultIndex` and `onIndexChange` read the step in focus. Zero runtime dependencies.
